subject: maths
question: Triangle BAC is similar to triangle PQR. The area of triangle BAC and triangle PQR is 25 cm² and 36 cm² respectively. If BA = 4 cm, then what is the length of PQ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of areas of similar triangles = (Ratio of corresponding sides)²

Area(ΔBAC) : Area(ΔPQR) = 25 : 36

Ratio of sides (BA : PQ) = √25 : √36 = 5 : 6

Given BA = 4 cm, so 5 units → 4 cm ⇒ 1 unit = 0.8 cm

Length of PQ = 6 units = 6 × 0.8 cm = 4.8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4.8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ΔBAC ∼ ΔPQR

Area(ΔBAC) = 25 cm²

Area(ΔPQR) = 36 cm²

Length of BA = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

For two similar triangles, Area₁ / Area₂ = (Side₁ / Side₂)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec49fa7cc9baddc691baec6bf89c94d9ddc275b4a4587a04a764aaaf03dac14e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area(ΔBAC) / Area(ΔPQR) = (BA / PQ)²

⇒ 25 / 36 = (4 / PQ)²

⇒ √(25 / 36) = 4 / PQ

⇒ 5 / 6 = 4 / PQ

⇒ 5 × PQ = 4 × 6

⇒ PQ = 24 / 5

⇒ PQ = 4.8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4.8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio of Perimeters

For similar triangles, the ratio of perimeters is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides: P₁/P₂ = S₁/S₂.

Ratio of Medians and Altitudes

The ratio of corresponding medians, altitudes, or angle bisectors of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Similarity Criteria

Triangles are similar if they satisfy AAA (Angle-Angle-Angle), SSS (Side-Side-Side ratio), or SAS (Side-Angle-Side ratio) conditions.</p
